zones.title: Context
zones.body: Session and market rows (return number, default language) and the short codes for the intent and the handoff reason from ar_codes.

zones.title: Return UUI
zones.body: AssemblePayload builds version;correlationId;sessionId;intent;reason;language plus caseId. FitsBudget checks 64 bytes; DropCaseId removes the case id first and logs it. EncodeUui hex-encodes and builds the Refer-To, stored on the session for the lookup endpoint. UpdateCaseContext prepopulates the CASE case with the full context before the transfer (joint scope step 8).

panels.title: AR-14 Build handoff
panels.body: The one place that knows the contact-center UUI format. Short codes come from ar_codes. FitsBudget: 64 bytes hex-encoded; the case ID is dropped first and logged, the correlation ID is never truncated. EncodeUui only encodes.
